reddit.title: Improving Performance for Flowing Lakes in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how flowing lakes are processed in Provincia. By optimizing our approach, drying one cell now only affects its immediate neighbors instead of rescanning the entire map. This change has reduced the script time for a 64×64 lake from around 20 ms to just 12 ms. Check out the full details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
